sources.title: Baidu frontend interview note identifying LeetCode 5 longest palindromic substring
Deterministic center-expansion validation against independent brute-force oracle

claims.text: The repository source identifies the Coding problem as longest palindromic substring (LeetCode 5); it does not preserve a language requirement or a tie-breaking rule among equal-length longest palindromes.

Enumerating both character and gap centers covers odd and even palindromes; deterministic tests plus 5000 randomized strings match an independent brute-force oracle under the explicitly chosen earliest-start tie rule.
The center-expansion implementation has O(n^2) worst-case time and O(1) auxiliary state excluding the returned substring; equal-character strings exercise the quadratic expansion boundary.
